FOLIO MIGRATION (c6251f0, 992cca1): src/design.rs new. Design<'a> = borrowed index over a folio StudioDocument + StudioDesignRecords + LocalContent (new() only indexes and never refuses; validate() = folio::validate_design_records mapped into ComponentsError, then the crate rules; validate_with_instance() = Folio validation of the record set with a successor instance). A component definition is the group layer folio StudioComponent.layer_id; definition nodes are the document layers under it (name, parent, sibling order from the document); set membership is a document fact (components whose layer is a child of the set layer). instance_resolution.rs: resolve_instance/propose_overrides/resolve_variable/swap_component/switch_variant/rematch_overrides operate on StudioComponentInstance, StudioOverrideRecord, StudioVariable, StudioVariableCollection, StudioValue, StudioPropertyValue; VariableTable::new(&collections,&variables) evaluates a record set without validation and refuses cycle/type/missing mode typed; propose_overrides returns a proposal only after the successor validates in Folio. constraints.rs: apply_constraints takes folio StudioConstraint, resize_component(design, component_id, new_size) reads StudioNodeDesign.constraints (default top_left) and NodeLocal rects. auto_layout.rs: solve_auto_layout(design, root_id, root_size, limits, cancel) builds a borrowed tree from the document + StudioAutoLayout/StudioChildLayout/StudioSizeClamps/StudioConstraint records; algorithm text unchanged. prototype.rs: reactions are the StudioReaction records of the per-node design entries; PrototypeFlow keeps only flow_id + start_frame_id; navigation ends the action array only for NODE/BACK/CLOSE (STU-PRO-104), URL/SET_VARIABLE actions do not.

stays_local.local_content: NodeLocal per definition layer: literal field values (StudioValue, never an alias), variable bindings (field -> SVAR), authored rect (x,y,w,h, document geometry unit). Folio notes left_out: node field values of definitions, bindings, layer geometry. An artboard root falls back to its Folio bounds.
stays_local.prototype_flow: PrototypeFlow{flow_id SPTF, start_frame_id}: Folio has no flow container (flow_starting_points not modelled).
stays_local.outputs_and_limits: RectPt/SizePt/PlacedNode/PlacedBox/AutoLayoutResult/Resolution/OverrideProposal/FlowReport, Limits/LayoutLimits/FlowLimits, footprints (check_footprint). Names RectPt/SizePt kept; units are the document geometry unit (points for a pt document).
stays_local.crate_rules: two or more members per set (STU-DS-102; Folio leaves it unenforced), SLOT refused, one source per field (literal vs binding AmbiguousSource), container rect required for definition geometry, container AUTO/FIXED vs child HUG/FILL/FIXED/grow/align agreement (Folio: not stated, not enforced), GRID/BASELINE/strokes_included_in_layout/hug+wrap refusals, CHANGE_TO/SCROLL_TO refused, check_value guard (finite numbers, bounded text, one easing function) for values that did not pass through Folio because folio's StudioValue::validate is crate-private

decisions: Design::new only indexes; evaluators stay defensive so a set that Folio refuses yields a typed refusal, never a loop (the alias cycle / alias type clash / missing mode value tests run the evaluator on a Folio-invalid set and also assert Folio's refusal)
STU-DS-113 label spelling is opaque in Folio: the label is matched to property_name exactly; an unknown label is UnsupportedProperty at resolution

Folio accepts only a component as StudioComponentInstance.main_component_id; the evaluator still accepts a set id (default variant, STU-DS-104) but a proposal whose successor names a set is refused by Folio (Folio(InvalidField main_component_id)); components-consumer now names the default member and selects the variant with a VARIANT property

Folio check_instances requires every instance property, VARIANT included, to have a property definition, so Folio-valid sets define a VARIANT property named like the variant group (default = the default variant's value)

Effective sizing of a node = its StudioChildLayout sizing, else the sizing implied by its own container modes (AUTO hug, FIXED fixed), else FIXED; missing child fields default INHERIT / grow 0 / AUTO; the root of a solve has no flow parent so FILL on a root comes only from a child record and is refused (fill_on_root)
Every node of a solved tree needs an authored rect (InvalidLayout rect_missing@id) except an artboard root (Folio bounds)

Any armed (non-null) trigger of the 17 StudioTrigger types counts for reachability; only NODE/BACK/CLOSE end the action array (STU-PRO-104); a reaction on a page spread is a node of the document (no owning frame, no edge)
FlowWarning.reaction_index is the index in the flow's reaction order = design entries in record order, each node's reactions in stored order; the warning also carries node_id

An override value may be a VARIABLE_ALIAS, and an instance property / property default may be an alias or carry bound_variable_id: all resolve through resolve_variable and their chains join the read footprint; bound_variable_id and an alias value naming different variables are AmbiguousSource(instance, property/<name>)

propose_overrides validates the successor by cloning the record set with the instance replaced and running folio::validate_design_records with folio::Unresolved (resolution issues are the host's, via Design::validate with its resolver); cost is O(records) per proposal
